review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this pending-decision case. The original PRD explicitly leaves material DEC-001 unresolved and makes AC-001 and AC-002 conditional recommendations, not authorization to choose OPT-1. Gold correctly requires blocked readiness with requirement-decision-pending for DEC-001 and evidence through repository, requirements, and decisions; B must stop at decisions rather than produce ready or assignable tasks. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, the repository identity/base commit, and the paired-case reference agree with the original specification. Empty assignment expectations are appropriate: TASK-IMPLEMENT and TASK-VERIFY apply only after resolution, and the frozen team catalog supplies no members, runtimes, or capability claims authorizing assignments. The complete supplied source supports index.js and index.d.ts as the implementation and public-contract owners, with test.js and index.test-d.ts as verification scope. package.json confirms the xo && ava && tsd verification entry point and provides no declaration-generation build evidence that would disqualify index.d.ts as a maintained owner. limitFunction forwards clearQueue and inherits its declaration through Pick, so these consumers do not require separate mandatory edits. Gold's releaseInput matches the frozen preview across repository/source/team/decision/prompt fingerprints, model identity, sampling fingerprint, metric-policy identity/version/digest, and budgets. The source-manifest digest and release source digest are distinct supplied fields, not evidence by themselves of an inconsistency. The original specification's null releaseInput and remaining preparation items describe the earlier preparation state; the supplied preview and Gold provide the frozen release input for this review. No hypothetical C or paired-case resolution is treated as a human Decision for this case. Approval is limited to the benchmark expectation, not implementation correctness, execution, assignment, or human confirmation. Digests are accepted as Service-calculated and mechanically bound to the saved inputs; I did not independently recompute them, execute code, or evaluate any candidate.
